items.name: Wings
items.description: Tossed in Buffalo, Jerk, BBQ, or Korean BBQ sauce. Dry Ranch or House Seasoning Dry Rub. Served with celery and your choice of bleu cheese or ranch.

items.name: French Fries with Truffle Dip
items.description: Scoop Fries, Parmesan served with Truffle Aioli

items.name: Elote Dip
items.description: Roasted Corn, Triple Cheese blend, Chipotle, house made tortilla chips.

items.name: Cheese Curds
items.description: Beer battered Ellsworth Cheese Curds served with a side of Ranch.

items.name: Nachos
items.description: Start with our house-made tortilla chips and add Jalapeno queso, pico de gallo, shredded lettuce, sport peppers, elote crema, and cilantro. Add: chicken tinga or seasoned ground beef $2. Serves 2-4.

items.description: 4 freshly baked pretzel loaves topped with Everything Bagel seasoning. Jalapeno queso on the side for dipping.

items.name: Chicago Beef Egg Rolls
items.description: Shaved ribeye, provolone, roasted red peppers, caramelized onion enveloped in an egg roll casing. Topped with spicy giardiniera. Au Jus for dipping.

items.name: Homemade Soup
items.description: Creamy Chicken Wild Rice or Soup of the Day

items.name: Fish & Chips
items.description: Crispy beer battered pollock served with french fries, honey-lime slaw and tartar sauce.

sections.title: SALADS
sections.subtitle: Add to any salad: chicken $3.00, fried shrimp $4.00

items.name: Apple and Berry Salad
items.description: Spring mix, candied walnuts, seasonal berries, apple, red onion, goat cheese and strawberry vinaigrette.

items.name: Classic Wedge Salad
items.description: Iceberg Lettuce, bacon, tomatoes, pickled red onion, blue cheese crumbles and dressing.

items.description: Iceberg and Romaine, shredded cheese, pico de gallo, sport peppers, cilantro, roasted corn, and elote crema served in crispy taco shell. Topped with tortilla strips. Add at no cost: chicken tinga or seasoned ground beef.

items.name: Caesar Salad
